---
title: "NAIA Women's Wrestling National Championships"
subtitle: "2026 Team Standings & Individual Weight Class Brackets"
---

Interactive results from the 2026 NAIA Women's Wrestling National Championships. Use the tabs below to view team standings or explore individual weight classes. Click any wrestler's row to view their individual match results.


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)

# Read the match data and team scores
matches <- read_csv("data/trackwrestling_matches.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
team_scores <- read_csv("data/trackwrestling_team_scores.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
all_matches <- read_csv("data/naia_matches_all_years.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Color badge helpers for match methods and results
badge_win_method <- \(value) {
  if (is.na(value) || value == "") return("")
  val <- tolower(as.character(value))
  col <- if (grepl("fall|vfa", val)) "#dc2626" else if (grepl("tf|tech|vsu", val)) "#7c3aed" else if (grepl("dec|vpo", val)) "#2563eb" else "#64748b"
  tags$span(
    style = sprintf("display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; background: %s18; color: %s;", col, col),
    value
  )
}

badge_result <- \(value) {
  if (is.na(value) || value == "") return("")
  col <- if (value == "Won") "#16a34a" else "#dc2626"
  tags$span(
    style = sprintf("display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; background: %s18; color: %s;", col, col),
    value
  )
}

# Clean, modern theme for all tables
tbl_theme <- reactableTheme(
  borderColor = "#e2e8f0",
  stripedColor = "#f8fafc",
  highlightColor = "#eff6ff",
  cellPadding = "8px 12px",
  headerStyle = list(
    backgroundColor = "#f8fafc",
    borderBottom = "2px solid #cbd5e1",
    fontWeight = 600,
    fontSize = "0.875rem",
    color = "#334155"
  )
)

# Extract podium placements from medal rounds
placements <- bind_rows(
  matches |> filter(round == "1st Place Match") |> transmute(weight_class, wrestler = winner, place = 1, finish = "👑 Champion"),
  matches |> filter(round == "1st Place Match") |> transmute(weight_class, wrestler = loser, place = 2, finish = "🥈 2nd Place"),
  matches |> filter(round == "3rd Place Match") |> transmute(weight_class, wrestler = winner, place = 3, finish = "🥉 3rd Place"),
  matches |> filter(round == "3rd Place Match") |> transmute(weight_class, wrestler = loser, place = 4, finish = "🏅 4th Place"),
  matches |> filter(round == "5th Place Match") |> transmute(weight_class, wrestler = winner, place = 5, finish = "🏅 5th Place"),
  matches |> filter(round == "5th Place Match") |> transmute(weight_class, wrestler = loser, place = 6, finish = "🏅 6th Place"),
  matches |> filter(round == "7th Place Match") |> transmute(weight_class, wrestler = winner, place = 7, finish = "🏅 7th Place"),
  matches |> filter(round == "7th Place Match") |> transmute(weight_class, wrestler = loser, place = 8, finish = "🏅 8th Place")
)

# Combine wins and losses so each wrestler has their full match log
wrestler_matches <- bind_rows(
  matches |> transmute(weight_class, wrestler = winner, school = winner_school, result = "Won", win_type, opponent = paste0(loser, " (", loser_school, ")"), round, score),
  matches |> transmute(weight_class, wrestler = loser, school = loser_school, result = "Lost", win_type, opponent = paste0(winner, " (", winner_school, ")"), round, score)
)

# Function to build an interactive table for any weight class
make_weight_table <- \(wt) {
  summary_df <- wrestler_matches |>
    filter(weight_class == wt) |>
    group_by(wrestler, school) |>
    summarize(
      wins = sum(result == "Won"),
      losses = sum(result == "Lost"),
      record = paste0(wins, "-", losses),
      pins = sum(result == "Won" & grepl("fall", tolower(win_type))),
      tfs = sum(result == "Won" & grepl("tech", tolower(win_type))),
      decs = sum(result == "Won" & grepl("dec", tolower(win_type))),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    left_join(placements |> filter(weight_class == wt), by = "wrestler") |>
    mutate(
      place = replace_na(place, 99),
      finish = replace_na(finish, "Competitor")
    ) |>
    arrange(place, desc(wins), losses)

  reactable(
    summary_df |> select(finish, wrestler, school, record),
    theme = tbl_theme,
    searchable = TRUE,
    striped = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE,
    bordered = TRUE,
    rowStyle = \(index) {
      if (summary_df$place[index] == 1) {
        list(background = "#fefce8", fontWeight = "600")
      }
    },
    columns = list(
      finish = colDef(
        name = "Finish",
        width = 150,
        align = "center",
        cell = \(value, index) {
          p <- summary_df$place[index]
          if (p == 1) {
            tags$span(
              style = "display: inline-block; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.85rem; background: #fef08a; color: #854d0e; border: 1.5px solid #facc15; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.4);",
              "👑 CHAMPION"
            )
          } else if (p == 2) {
            tags$span(style = "display: inline-block; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8rem; background: #f1f5f9; color: #334155; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;", "🥈 2nd Place")
          } else if (p == 3) {
            tags$span(style = "display: inline-block; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8rem; background: #ffedd5; color: #9a3412; border: 1px solid #fed7aa;", "🥉 3rd Place")
          } else if (p <= 8) {
            tags$span(style = "display: inline-block; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8rem; background: #eff6ff; color: #1d4ed8; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;", paste0("🏅 ", p, "th Place"))
          } else {
            tags$span(style = "color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.8rem;", "Competitor")
          }
        }
      ),
      wrestler = colDef(name = "Wrestler"),
      school = colDef(name = "School"),
      record = colDef(name = "Record (W-L)", align = "center")
    ),
    details = \(index) {
      row <- summary_df[index, ]
      sub_matches <- wrestler_matches |>
        filter(weight_class == wt, wrestler == row$wrestler) |>
        select(round, opponent, result, score)

      div(
        style = "padding: 16px 20px; background: #f8fafc; border-radius: 10px; margin: 8px 0; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;",
        
        # Header profile card
        div(
          style = "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;",
          div(
            h5(style = "margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;", paste0("🤼‍♀️ ", row$wrestler)),
            span(style = "color: #64748b; font-size: 0.875rem;", row$school)
          ),
          div(
            span(
              style = paste0(
                "display: inline-block; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85rem; ",
                if (row$place == 1) "background: #fef08a; color: #854d0e; border: 1px solid #facc15;"
                else if (row$place <= 8) "background: #eff6ff; color: #1d4ed8; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;"
                else "background: #f1f5f9; color: #64748b;"
              ),
              row$finish
            )
          )
        ),
        
        # Fun Stat Pills
        div(
          style = "display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 14px;",
          span(style = "background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: #334155;",
            paste0("📊 Record: ", row$record)
          ),
          span(style = "background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: #dc2626;",
            paste0("📌 Pins: ", row$pins)
          ),
          span(style = "background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: #7c3aed;",
            paste0("⚡ Tech Falls: ", row$tfs)
          ),
          span(style = "background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2563eb;",
            paste0("⏱️ Decisions: ", row$decs)
          )
        ),
        
        # Match History Table
        reactable(
          sub_matches,
          theme = tbl_theme,
          outlined = TRUE,
          striped = TRUE,
          columns = list(
            round = colDef(name = "Round"),
            opponent = colDef(name = "Opponent"),
            result = colDef(name = "Result", width = 85, align = "center", cell = badge_result),
            score = colDef(name = "Score")
          )
        )
      )
    }
  )
}
```

## Team Standings

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 4.5
team_scores |>
  slice_max(score, n = 10) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = score, y = reorder(team, score))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2563eb", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = score), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = "#1e293b") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Team Finishes",
    subtitle = "Total team points at the 2026 National Championship",
    caption = "Source: TrackWrestling",
    x = "Team Points",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
reactable(
  team_scores |> select(place, team, score),
  theme = tbl_theme,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 10,
  columns = list(
    place = colDef(name = "Place", width = 75, align = "center"),
    team = colDef(name = "Team"),
    score = colDef(name = "Points", width = 95, align = "right")
  ),
  searchable = TRUE
)
```

## All-Time Matches (2019–2026)

```{r}
#| echo: false
reactable(
  all_matches,
  theme = tbl_theme,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 15,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  pageSizeOptions = c(10, 15, 25, 50, 100),
  columns = list(
    year = colDef(name = "Year", width = 80, align = "center"),
    weight_class = colDef(name = "Weight", width = 85, align = "center"),
    round = colDef(name = "Round", minWidth = 130),
    winner = colDef(name = "Winner", minWidth = 140),
    winner_school = colDef(name = "Winner School", minWidth = 140),
    win_method = colDef(name = "Method", width = 110, align = "center", cell = badge_win_method),
    score = colDef(name = "Score / Time", minWidth = 100),
    loser = colDef(name = "Loser", minWidth = 140),
    loser_school = colDef(name = "Loser School", minWidth = 140)
  )
)
```
